content: Seikop oh eh Peneinei Mweselahng Isip
Seikop eri kihpene eh kepwe kan koaros oh mwesellahng Peersepa, e ahpw wiahda meirong kei ong Koht en seme, Aisek, wasao.
Koht eri mahsanihong Seikop ni kasansal ehu nipwong, mahsanih, “Seikop, Seikop!” E ahpw patohwan sapeng, “Iet ngehi, maing.”
E ahpw mahsanih, “Ngehi Koht, Koht en semomw, ke dehr perki kohla Isip; pwe I pahn wiahkihla kadaudokomw kan wehi lapalap ehu wasao.
I pahn iang uhk kohwei Isip, oh I pil pahn kapwurehdo kadaudokomw kan wasaht. Sosep pahn mi rehmw ni omw pahn mehla.”
Seikop eri mweselsang Peersepa. Nah pwutak ko eri kidahng Seikop, nair seri tikitik ko, oh ar pwoud ko, pohn werennansapw ko me Parao ketin kadarala pwe re en dake.
Irail eri wahda nair mahn ako, oh iangahki mehkoaros me re ahneki nan Kenan oh mwesellahng Isip. Seikop wa kohdihla kadaudoke kan koaros:
nah pwutak ko, nah serepein ko, oh neirail seri ko.
Tohn peneineien Seikop me iang ih patohlahng Isip iei nah pwutak laud Reupen
oh nein Reupen pwutak ko: Anok, Pallu, Esron, oh Karmi.
Simion oh nah pwutak ko: Semuel, Samin, Ohad, Sakin, Sohar, oh Saul, nein lih lidu en Kenan men.
Lipai oh nah pwutak ko: Kerson, Kohad, oh Merari.
Suda oh nah pwutak ko: Sela, Peres, oh Sera. (Nein Suda pwutak teiko, Er oh Onan, ira mehla nan Kenan.) Nein Peres pwutak iei Esron oh Amul.
Isakar oh nah pwutak ko: Tola, Pua, Sasup, oh Simron.
Sepulon oh nah pwutak ko: Sered, Elon, oh Saleel.
Ih met kan pwutak ko me Lia wiahiong Seikop nan Mesopodamia, iangahki Daina. Nah kan koaros sang Lia patpene wiahda me siliakan silimen.
Kad oh nah pwutak ko: Sepohn, Aki, Suni, Espon, Eri, Arod, oh Areli.
Aser oh nah pwutak ko: Imna, Ispa, Ispi, Peria, oh riarail serepein Sera. Nein Peria pwutak kan iei Eper oh Malkiel.
Me ehk wenemen pwutak iei kadaudok en Seikop sang Silpa, lidu serepein me Lapan kihong nah serepein Lia.
Resel, en Seikop eh pwoud, wiahiong pwutak riemen: Sosep oh Pensamin.
Nan Isip Sosep wiahda pwutak riemen: Manase oh Epraim, sang Asenad, nein Podipera serepein, samworo men nan Iliopolis.
Nein Pensamin pwutak kan iei Pela, Peker, Aspel, Kera, Nahman, Ehi, Ros, Muppin, oh Ard.
Me ehk pahmen pwukat iei kadaudok en Seikop sang Resel.
Dan oh nah pwutak Usim.
Napdali oh nah pwutak ko: Sasehl, Kuni, Seser, oh Sillem.
Me isimen pwukat iei kadaudok en Seikop sang Pila, lidu serepein me Lapan kihong nah serepein Resel.
Eri, irail koaros kadaudok en Seikop ko me kohdilahng Isip me wenehk wenemen, a en nah pwutak ko ar pwoud ko sohte wadohng.
Nein Sosep pwutak riemen me ipwidi nan Isip, eri, irail koaros me kolahng wasao me isiakan.
Sosep oh eh Peneinei nan Isip
Seikop eri kadarala Suda mwowe rehn Sosep pwe en peki en tuhwong nan Kosen. Ni ar lel wasao,
Sosep ahpw ketin kaunopada sapwellime werennansapw oh ketilahng Kosen pwe en tuhwong eh pahpa Seikop. Eri, ni eh tuhwong, e pwoalehdi oh tentenihr ahnsou reirei.
Seikop ahpw ndahng Sosep, “Met I kakehr mehla, ni ei kilanguhkehr oh eseier me ke momourte.”
Sosep eri mahsanihong rie ko oh eh peneinei, “I pahn kolahng ndahng Parao me peneineien ei pahpao, patohdohsangehr Kenan, wasa re kin koukousoan ie, oh re patodohr rehi.
I pahn ndaiong me kumwail silepen sihpw kei oh kin apwahpwalih pelinmen kan oh kumwail wa kohdo noumwail pelinmen kan oh mehkoaros me kumwail ahneki.
Eri, ni Parao eh pahn malipei kumwail oh keinemwe da amwail doadoahk,

kumwail pahn sapengki me kumwail kin apwalih pelinmen kan sang ni amwail tikitik, duwen me amwail pahpa kahlap ako kin wia. Pwe ma ih duwe met, e pahn ketin mweidohng kumwail en kousoan nan Kosen.” Sosep mahsanih met pwehki mehn Isip sohte kin mwahuki silepen sihpw kan.
